# District 2 Elections

States of Jersey elections held in District 2 — St Brelade — since 2022:

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-2#deputies)**

**[St Brelade Elections](https://flow.je/elections/st-brelade)**

* * *

* * *

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Dr Helen Miles](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/helen-miles), [Moz Scott](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/moz-scott), [Dr Jonathan Renouf](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jonathan-renouf) and [Montfort Tadier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier) were elected as Deputies of District 2 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Dr Helen Miles](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/helen-miles)** |  | 2,370 | 75.5% |
| 2 | **[Moz Scott](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/moz-scott)** |  | 1,785 | 56.9% |
| 3 | **[Dr Jonathan Renouf](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jonathan-renouf)** |  | 1,782 | 56.8% |
| 4 | **[Montfort Tadier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier)** | Reform Jersey | 1,503 | 47.9% |
| 5 | [Steve Pallett](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-pallett) | The Progress Party | 1,328 | 42.3% |
| 6 | [Nigel Jones](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nigel-jones) | Reform Jersey | 888 | 28.3% |
| 7 | [Steve Bailey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-bailey) | The Progress Party | 662 | 21.1% |
| 8 | [James Corbett KC](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/james-corbett) | Jersey Alliance | 421 | 13.4% |
| 9 | [Karl Busch](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/karl-busch) |  | 162 | 5.2% |

3,138 ballots (inc. 6 spoilt papers)

8,043 registered voters

39% turnout

* * *

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Gabriel Raimondo](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gabriel-raimondo) : New Candidate \[[app.jerseyeveningpost.com](https://app.jerseyeveningpost.com/former-minister-plans-comeback-with-reform/content.html)\]
- [Dr Jonathan Renouf](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jonathan-renouf) : Current Deputy of District 2 \[[x.com](https://x.com/JonathanRenouf/status/2032747505658499231)\]
- [Montfort Tadier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier) : Current Deputy of District 2 (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/02/long-standing-st-brelade-deputy-to-stand-again/)\]
- [John Young](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-young) : Previous States Member (Reform Jersey) \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/02/former-environment-minister-to-seek-states-return-and-joins-reform-jersey/)\]
